description: A Class B, C or D shelf's altitudes as the sectional writes them, for the label the 3D map stands at the shelf's top: the ceiling over the floor in hundreds of feet MSL, the last two zeros omitted, "SFC" for the surface ("100" over "30", "100" over "SFC"); a Class C ceiling to but not including the floor of the Class B over it "T"; a Class D its ceiling alone, with a minus where it is from the surface to but not including it ("-30"). FAA Aeronautical Chart User's Guide, 9 July 2026, VFR Terms and Symbols, Airspace (p. 16) and its legend Airspace Information (p. 52). The limits as the planner sends a NASR Class Airspace volume (floor_ft with floor_ref SFC, AGL or MSL; ceiling_ft MSL; ceiling_excluded for UPPER_DESC TNI). Null for another class, a Class E surface area among them, or a shelf with no ceiling.

ceiling_excluded.description: The ceiling is to but not including its figure (NASR UPPER_DESC TNI).

ceiling.description: The ceiling as the chart writes it: "100", "T", "-30".

floor.description: The floor as the chart writes it, "30" or "SFC"; null for a Class D.

text.description: The label as the map sets it: the ceiling, a line break and the floor; a Class D's ceiling alone.
